rule.fail_rule: KANI_FAIL iff Kani reported the harness FAILED (a counterexample to its assertion); the run id is cited and a finding is preserved
rule.not_reachable_rule: KANI_NOT_REACHABLE iff a stated harness has no run record; it is not a clean result
rule.pass_rule: KANI_PASS iff the named harness was run by the installed Kani against the exact admitted candidate and the transcript reports its assertions SUCCESSFUL with zero failures; the harness cites the run id and the run's command hash
rule.unsupported_rule: KANI_UNSUPPORTED iff Kani could not compile or express the target (e.g. the crate's FFI panic guard) or the venue could not run the instrument; the reason is recorded
